profile.headline: Full Stack Web Developer | Programmer
profile.summary:
Hello, I am a freelance Full Stack Web Developer with over 25
years of experience. I strive to create an efficient, user friendly
solution customized to your business needs. Let’s talk. 

Technical Skills: HTML5, CSS3, JQUERY, JAVASCRIPT, PHP, XML, MySQL, ASP.NET, C#, SQL, WORDPRESS

positions.title: Full Stack Web Developer
positions.description:
Created web pages to search/display Stock Market predictions
based on algorithmic trading patterns/formulas.

positions.title: Freelance Full Stack Web Developer | Web Designer | Programmer
positions.description:
Pursuing my passion of developing cutting edge websites and software solutions. I specialize in creating highly functional websites utilizing databases, server-side script and dynamic, interactive code while incorporating appealing visual effects.  Please visit my online portfolio at www.heidilee.net/portfolio.
•	Excellent communication skills, detail oriented, flexible and a fast learner.
•	Enthusiastic, self-starter, goal-oriented, organized, efficient and hard working professional.

positions.title: Full Stack Web Developer | Programmer
positions.description: I continue to work with the CPS Team on a contract basis as a Full Stack Web Developer.

positions.title: Web Developer | Programmer
positions.description: Worked with upper management to design and brand 8 corporate websites using ASP, ASP.NET, PHP, HTML, CSS, JavaScript, SQL, Access. Optimized sites for organic SEO.  Custom designed Lead Tracking CRM program for sales staff using ASP, JavaScript and SQL.  Features include pop up Alert Reminders, search options, Accounting and Profit Analysis  Reports. Also an automated query that reassigns the lead to Open status based on last action date and activity.  Designed and maintain company Intranet site in Sharepoint 2007. Designed pages in ASP.NET and customized web parts with JavaScript for dynamic page activity.

positions.title: Marketing Supervisor
positions.description:
Directed and managed the workflow of internal staff.
Provided support and training to national Sales Reps.
Designed and created hard copy and web-based marketing materials including easy to follow, step by step procedure manuals, training guides and interactive knowledge quizzes.
Reported company statistics to upper management by building queries. Maintained the corporate matrix database which generates decision callbacks to dealers based on application input. Built dynamic dashboards using Excel Services.

positions.title: Full Stack Web Developer
positions.description:
Created custom web-based CRM program for lead tracking,
customer follow-up, online forms, deal summary calculator, profit
tracking, API integration to phone records

positions.title: Web Developer | Programmer
positions.description: Update website design and online features for restaurant delivery company. Designed mobile device application for drivers. Hand coded SmartyPHP, jQuery, Ajax, Javascript, HTML5, CSS3, MySQL.

positions.title: Web Developer | Programmer
positions.description: Team development – ASP.net MVC, C#, HTML5, CSS3, jQuery and PHP. Created pages based off photoshop mockups from designer. Coded parallax scrolling pages.

positions.title: Web Developer | Programmer
positions.description: Worked with development team to rebrand corporate websites - code and design pages based off photoshop mockups.  Update and maintain current clientele websites/database. Hand coded HTML5, CSS3, PHP, ASP.NET, SQL, MYSQL, JAVASCRIPT, JQUERY.  Created banners, buttons, images in Photoshop.

positions.title: Web Developer | Programmer
positions.description:
Working with development team to create an advanced and customized Contact Management Database System for large corporation. 

Hand coding pages using ASP.NET, C#, JQuery, CSS and SQL.

positions.title: Web Developer | Programmer
positions.description: Worked with IT Team to create web-based Asset Management workflow systems. Programmed customized and dynamic applications and dashboards using ASP, JavaScript and SQL database.
